review_state: production rev 1 - M1, awaiting owner look review
purpose: M1 step 3 territorial rammer body (role: territorial): a pale, leathery domed pebble with three dark bands, a veined dorsal crest with threat-coloured points and frowning lids. Body only; its spikes and other parts come from the part GLBs.

textures.name: T_Rammer_Albedo
textures.packing: greyscale albedo detail (baked AO darkens crevices), times each material's base colour

textures.name: T_Rammer_ORM
textures.packing: R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

frame.source: game/scenes/pool/part_placement.gd RX and RZ; the part GLBs sit on this outline at the swim plane

pivot: body centre on the swim plane (Godot y = 0); built at size 1, the creature view scales it by the species' body_size

pose_nodes.Eye_L: child of Body, origin at the eye's centre (with Pupil_L and Lid_L)
pose_nodes.Hood: child of Body: the dorsal crest, origin at the middle of its base on the back; scale its up axis (Godot +Y) to raise it in the puff

vertex_colors.encoding: sRGB-encoded in COLOR_0; the engine material sets vertex_color_is_srgb (assets/export/M_RammerBody.tres)
vertex_colors.note: Pale sand with three dark bands across the back that fade down the flanks, a cream belly.

reduction.method: Blender collapse decimation within a surface tolerance; body vertex colours kept within 0.04 per channel; full-detail shading (a body built at a finer tessellation) baked to the normal map

provenance: Authored procedurally in Blender by tools/blender/make_m1_production.py; no external or generated meshes. Textures baked in Blender from procedural shaders.
